text.p: Tropical cyclone Drena is becoming an extratropical storm system as it tracks rapidly towards the south-southeast in the region to the northwest of New Zealand. This system should be an extratropical storm as it moves into New Zealand in 24-36 hours. Winds up to 50 mph may cause some property damage when this system tracks across. Locally heavy rains may cause flooding and possible mudslides during this time. The storm is still somewhat of a risk to shipping in the region but this risk will diminish during the next 12-24 hours.
Tropical Cyclone Fabriola has dissipated south of Madagascar. It is no longer a significant risk to shipping.
THERE ARE NO FURTHER EMERGENCY WEATHER STATEMENTS
